validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (high, real): P6737 = MGS-3 Package 17, the Jizan (Jazan) cluster laterals. Independently documented across non-GEM origins: MEED (trade press, the source the sheet already cites) package table -> 'Lay lateral pipelines (30-inch and 16-inch) in the Jizan cluster (169 km)'; Blackridge Research project profile carries the same Package 17 line (contractor Kalpataru Power Transmission); DMS Projects and BNC Network also carry MGS-3 Phase 3 Package 17 records. Not a GEM-derived entity. CLASSIFICATION (transmission defensible, caveat): Package 17 is a 30/16-inch lateral package, not a 56-inch mainline, but MEED groups all 15 pipe packages as 'gas transport pipelines' and the sibling lateral rows (P6732/P6733/P6735/P6736) are all recorded transmission, so PipelineType=transmission is consistent. Fuel=Gas correct. DUPLICATE (checked, NOT a duplicate): distinct package from the other western/lateral rows — P6735 = Package 15, 192 km, Yanbu->Rabigh; P6736 = Package 16, 52 km, Jeddah; P6737 = Package 17, Jizan. Diameter signature 30,16 is unique to Package 17 among the roster, so no relabel/segment double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct (Aramco's own Master Gas System). Endpoints given only as 'the Jizan cluster' — no discrete start/end nodes disclosed, so StartLocation/EndLocation remain unfillable; province = Jazan (staged as a fill; the Jizan cluster lies in Jazan Province). SPEC — MATERIAL DISAGREEMENT: GEM records LengthKnown=196 km, but the sheet's OWN cited source (MEED) and an independent second source (Blackridge) both state the Package 17 / Jizan cluster length is 169 km, not 196. Two independent origins agree on 169; nothing supports 196 (likely a transcription slip, not the 192 km of the adjacent Package 15). Diameter 30,16 in agrees across MEED + Blackridge (2 independent, value present) — high, correct. Capacity not disclosed per package — left blank, not fabricated. StartYear1=2028 matches the Q4-2028 MGS-3 in-service target (MEED/Blackridge). Flagging length as a spec concern rather than silently passing.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' still correct. MGS-3 EPC packages (including Package 17, Jizan cluster, contractor Kalpataru) were awarded in 2024; construction commenced Q2 2024 with target completion Q4 2028 (MEED + Blackridge, independent origins). Blackridge's live project profile continues to list MGS-3 in construction with the Q4-2028 completion date, and program-wide active construction was still being reported through 2025 (e.g. L&T completing 56-inch sections of the same MGS-3 program, Pipeline Journal Sep-2025). No independent start-up/commissioning announcement for the Jizan laterals, so not 'operating'. Far under any dormancy threshold (awarded 2024, active 2025). StartYear1=2028 matches the Q4-2028 target.
